messages:
Nina (CSE): Heads-up 1 HelioPayments rolled out PaymentsAssist to 3 new squads (Risk, Reconciliation, Sales Ops). They started high-volume reconciliation runs today and are seeing intermittent 429s and some >500ms tail latency. They're asking about per-squad quotas, predictable monthly cost, and whether a committed pool makes sense before renewal (in ~6 weeks). cc @Caleb @Olive

Caleb (CS Ops): Can you share rough qps and token sizes for each squad? Backfill vs live?

Nina (CSE): Live traffic. Risk: 45 seats, prompts ~1.2k tokens, replies 300-500 tokens, peak ~3 reqs/sec/seat. Reconciliation: async batch nightly ~1.2M items over 10h (avg text short), Sales Ops: 20 seats, multi-turn sales playbooks, longer responses up to 900 tokens. Tenant qps ~440 steady with bursts to ~950. They reported ~40 429s in last 6h and a few user complaints about slow responses.

Ibrahim (Eng-runtime): This pattern looks like KV cache churn from multi-team usage + batching saturation during bursts. Short-term mitigations: per-squad concurrency caps, route reconciliation backfill to a dedicated ingest lane, and enable tenant pinning to a canary pool. For durable predictability, Dedicated is recommended.

Olive (AE): I'll offer a 10-day committed trial for a small dedicated pool focused on Reconciliation to validate both cost and latency. Need an estimate of GPU-hours for the nightly backfill and expected cost delta. Renewal will hinge on finance seeing predictable spend.

Rhea (Product): Noted feature asks: per-squad quota UI in Console, per-squad cost estimator, and message-level squad tags in audit logs. Also request a bulk-ingest estimator widget. Can you capture exact log fields they need?

Nina (CSE): Sample sanitized payloads:
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-medium-2025",
  "messages": ["system: reconcile accounting entries","user: csv row payload..."],
  "max_tokens": 600
}
```
and backfill job snippet:
```json
{ "job_id": "hp-recon-042", "items": 1200000, "model": "embed-fast-xl", "batch_size": 512 }
```
They also asked for clearer per-squad spend breakdown in the billing export.

Ibrahim (Eng-runtime): I'll open infra ticket INF-9744 for canary pinning + backfill routing. Quick canary config we can try (trial only):
```yaml
tenant: heliopayments-recon
backfill_route: dedicated-ingest-2
kv_retention: extended
squad_concurrency: {reconciliation: 4, risk: 6, salesops: 3}
pinned_pool: hp-committed-trial-3x
```

Caleb (CS Ops): OPS-8122 created to provision `hp-committed-trial-3x` (requesting 3 GPUs for 10 days). ETA provisioning ~18h.

Olive (AE): I'll prepare renewal scenarios: A) seat-based + burst credits (lower near-term cost), B) committed pool (predictable monthly). If trial yields >30% reduction in tail 429s and cost delta <25%, I'll recommend B.

ops-bot: Committed trial pool `hp-committed-trial-3x` provisioned for tenant heliopayments-recon (expires in 10 days).

Nina (CSE): Plan: 1) Ibrahim -> INF-9744 + apply canary when pool is live, 2) Caleb -> OPS-8122 follow-up for quotas, 3) Olive -> renewal scenarios and finance brief, 4) Rhea -> collect audit-log field requirements and console UX needs. I'll run an enablement session with their ops leads Monday. Renewal risk: medium until trial validates predictable billing. I'll post canary metrics (p50/p95/p99, 429s, cost delta) in this thread during the pilot. :spiral_calendar:
